title: “Selective re-coupling”: digital capability configurations and financial resilience across stages of uncertainty
task: Digital capability configuration and financial resilience dynamics in Chinese SMEs under uncertainty
key_results: No universally necessary antecedent; lean digital arrangements resilient in shock phase; agility+precision+governance needed in later stages (fsQCA + random forest)
comments: Selective re-coupling framework reframes resilience as configurational and stage-dependent rather than cumulative; sample restricted to Specialized/Refined/Differentiated/Innovative firms.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Financial resilience is a stage-dependent configurational outcome, not driven by single digital investments
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; distinct shock/recovery/deepening configurations identified

title: The co-evolution of peer reward mechanisms and cooperation
task: Co-evolution of peer reward mechanisms and cooperation in public goods games
key_results: Endogenous reward fraction increases over time; full contributions reached at 33% tax threshold; both contributions and reward voting increase with tax rate
comments: Laboratory experiment validates self-determined peer sanctions sustain cooperation without external enforcement; external validity to real-world voluntary institutions limited.

model_io.model: Public goods game with endogenous reward mechanism selection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Players endogenously adopt higher peer reward fractions, sustaining cooperation without external mandate
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; tax rates increase over time; full contributions at 33%

title: From prompts to profiles: how AI literacy profiles and genre-based writing tasks relate to linguistic complexity in L2 writing
task: AI literacy profiles and linguistic complexity in L2 writing across genres
key_results: Four distinct AI literacy profiles; profile effects task-sensitive; narrative reduces lexical diversity for mid-profiles; expository increases clause elaboration for Profile 4
comments: Person-centered profiling + multidimensional complexity measures captures profile-task interaction; under time pressure reflects realistic L2 writing conditions.

model_io.model: Latent profile analysis (AI literacy) × MANOVA (linguistic complexity across genres)
inputs: AI literacy survey (conceptual understanding, application, ethics, self-efficacy)
timed L2 essays (narrative, persuasive, expository, cause-effect)

hypotheses.hypothesis: AI literacy profiles interact with writing genre to produce heterogeneous linguistic outcomes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; narrative, persuasive, expository tasks show distinct profile-complexity patterns

title: Artificial intelligence needs better health systems to reduce inequalities
task: Governance framework for equitable AI in healthcare
key_results: Identified five interconnected governance domains; highlighted cascading weaknesses across legal, regulatory, workforce, and public trust dimensions
comments: Perspective piece rather than empirical study; lacks quantitative evidence for proposed reforms but usefully frames systemic interconnections.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Weak governance in one domain cascades to weaken others, amplifying health inequalities
hypotheses.result: Conceptual framework proposed; empirical validation needed

title: A nanocrystal-based PN junction model for quantum dot light-emitting diodes
task: Model PN junction characteristics in quantum dot light-emitting diodes
key_results: Modified nano-PN junction model combining silicon PN junction and hopping transport predicts high QLED ideality factors; voltage distribution and Quasi-Fermi level splitting elucidated
comments: Nanocrystal-based junction framework bridges semiconductor physics and QLED design; recombination-current dominance assumption validates high-efficiency device behavior.

hypotheses.hypothesis: QLED high ideality factors arise from recombination current dominance and nanocrystal transport physics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via theoretical framework and I-V curve simulation

title: Optical anisotropy enables skyrmions for robust information encoding
task: Realize robust skyrmions through optical anisotropy for topological information encoding
key_results: Generalized skyrmion construction via parameter space dimensionality reduction; directly readable and perturbation-robust skyrmionic states demonstrated
comments: Paradigm shift beyond sphere-valued vector fields enables practical topological encoding in structured optical systems.

title: Charge-spin dichotomy in the kagome metal CsCr3Sb5
task: Resolve intertwined charge and spin orders in kagome metal CsCr3Sb5
key_results: Distinct charge-density-wave transition at T ≈ 64 K and spin-density-wave order below T* ≈ 55 K; three-domain spin structures revealed by photoemission-electron microscopy
comments: Elastoresistivity measurements identify rotational symmetry breaking without divergent nematic susceptibility, providing crucial insight into pressure-induced superconductivity origins.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CsCr3Sb5 exhibits distinct charge and spin ordering transitions absent in single-transition description
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by elastoresistivity and photoemission-electron microscopy

title: Targeted polar entropy regulation enables superior energy-storage in tungsten bronze multilayer capacitors
task: Enhance dielectric energy storage in tungsten bronze ceramics via polar entropy regulation
key_results: Recoverable energy density of 17.6 J·cm−3 with 96.8% efficiency (figure of merit 550); thermal stability ΔWrec ≤ 2.0% over −40 to 125 °C
comments: Multi-element B-site substitution strategy is practical and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance for multilayer capacitor applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Polar-entropy regulation via B-site substitution weakens polar nanoregion coupling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by atomic-scale characterization and improved recoverable energy density

title: The impact of spurious imaginary phonon modes on thermal properties of Metal-organic Frameworks
task: Quantify impact of spurious imaginary phonon modes on MOF thermal property predictions
key_results: Spurious modes cause substantial heat capacity errors and incorrect MOF ranking; post-processing workflow effectively corrects estimates
comments: Addresses critical DFT convergence issue affecting computational screening of MOFs for direct air capture applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spurious imaginary phonon modes from underconverged DFT calculations introduce systematic heat capacity errors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; benchmarking MLIPs against contaminated datasets misrepresents model performance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Simple post-processing workflow can correct spurious mode artifacts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; proposed workflow effectively recovers accurate heat capacity estimates

title: Electromechanical docking and undocking mechanisms for thin-film robotic and electronic modules based on kinetic electronics
task: Develop active electromechanical docking mechanisms for thin-film modular robotic and electronic systems
key_results: Probe assembly deformation of 10 mm at 1.1 W; separation module mean power 0.43 W with max holding force 618 mgf (6.1 mN); simultaneous mechanical and electrical continuity achieved
comments: Kinetic electronics approach enables reversible active interconnection at module scale; persistent coupling in unpowered state demonstrates practical reconfigurability.

title: Photonic qubit gates via 1D scattering from an array of two-level emitters
task: Implement deterministic phase gate for photonic qubits using 1D waveguide coupled to two-level emitters
key_results: Transfer matrix protocol achieves high-fidelity phase gate for dual-rail photonic qubits; robust against non-waveguide coupling and disorder with finite-bandwidth pulses
comments: Label-free approach leveraging 1D scattering provides deterministic operation advantage over probabilistic schemes; extension to two-qubit gates discussed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic phase gate via 1D scattering maintains high fidelity despite disorder and realistic pulse bandwidth
hypotheses.result: Confirmed

title: Observation of a commensurate super modulation consistent with an intertwined charge density wave and antiferromagnetic phase in monolayer 1T-NbSe2
task: Identify intertwined charge-density-wave and antiferromagnetic order in monolayer 1T-NbSe2
key_results: Long-wavelength supermodulation commensurate with Star-of-David CDW; noncollinear antiferromagnetic order entangled with CDW
comments: STM/STS observation of commensurate supermodulation combined with Landau theory and DFT reveals complex interplay of electronic correlation and magnetism in 2D quantum materials.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Charge and spin degrees of freedom are coupled in monolayer 1T-NbSe2
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; supermodulation explained by CDW-AFM entanglement

title: Calorimetric evidence for excess heat generation in a proton–LaB$$_{6}$$ glow-discharge system
task: Investigate excess heat generation in proton–LaB6 glow-discharge system
key_results: Integrated gain values exceeding unity observed under specific high-power discharge conditions; excess energy unresolved in origin
comments: Calorimetry calibrated to ISO/IEC 17025 standards; LaB6 cathode-specific phenomenon not reproduced with tungsten, but physical mechanism remains unexplained.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Specific LaB6 cathode properties enable excess thermal output under nonequilibrium plasma conditions
hypotheses.result: Partially supported; effect observed only with LaB6 near plasma instability conditions, but physical origin unresolved

title: Human-organ-scale x-ray fluorescence ghost imaging for radioisotope-free diagnostics
task: Develop radioisotope-free tracer imaging using X-ray fluorescence ghost imaging
key_results: Spatial resolution ~4.5 mm in thyroid phantom with iodine distribution reconstruction; avoids radioactive tracers
comments: Proof-of-concept demonstrates a generalizable non-radionuclide imaging modality with potential for further resolution improvement through system optimization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured illuminations combined with fluorescence detection can reconstruct tracer distribution without radionuclides
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with high-fidelity iodine distribution maps at 4.5 mm resolution

title: Full energy partitioning in 2 μm wavelength laser driven extreme ultraviolet sources
task: Complete energy partitioning in 2 μm wavelength-driven EUV laser-produced plasma
key_results: ~70% of laser energy converted to photons (5–80 nm range); ~30% to plasma ions with fraction decreasing at higher laser intensity
comments: Benchmark for solid-state 2 μm laser-driven EUV sources demonstrates promising efficiency pathway versus traditional 10.6 μm CO2 systems for nanolithography.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Plasma ion energy fraction decreases with increasing laser intensity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; key insight for industrial optimization

title: Core elements play distinct roles in promoter birth and transcriptional regulation
task: Determine functional roles of core promoter elements (−35 and −10) in E. coli transcription
key_results: −10 element is essential for promoter birth from random sequences; −35 element is dispensable for promoter emergence but critical for regulation via transcription factor interactions; evolution optimizes −35/−10 sequences in regulated promoters to maximize fold-changes by lowering basal and elevating induced expression
comments: The discovery that −35 and −10 elements have functionally distinct, non-redundant roles in promoter evolution versus regulation provides valuable design principles, though the leaky expression exception (PluxI) suggests biological contexts require case-by-case validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Both −35 and −10 elements are equally essential for promoter birth
hypotheses.result: Contradicted: −10 essential, −35 dispensable for promoter evolution from random sequences

hypotheses.hypothesis: −35 element exerts primary control on basal transcription levels
hypotheses.result: Contradicted: −35 primarily impacts regulation via transcription factor coordination

hypotheses.hypothesis: Evolution tunes regulated promoters to maximize fold-changes by lowering basal expression
hypotheses.result: Supported: −35/−10 coevolution achieves near-maximal fold-changes via basal suppression and induced elevation

title: Paradoxical regional contrasts in the resilience of marine zooplankton to climatic warming
task: Assess zooplankton resilience to regional climate warming across North Sea and NE Atlantic
key_results: North Sea warmed 2× faster but showed greater copepod population stability; NE Atlantic experienced range shifts up to 139 km/decade northward and population declines; seasonal phenological shifts up to 39 days earlier per °C across both regions
comments: The finding that faster warming correlates with greater resilience challenges temperature-centric ecosystem models and highlights the importance of regional food availability and hydrodynamics in buffering climate impacts.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Faster warming in North Sea would reduce resilience due to thermal stress
hypotheses.result: Contradicted: North Sea showed greater resilience despite 2× warming rate

hypotheses.hypothesis: Regional conditions (food/advection) buffer copepod populations from warming effects
hypotheses.result: Supported: North Sea's high food and advection maintained stable abundance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Range shifts correlate with phenological shifts in North Sea
hypotheses.result: Supported: Species with greater range shifts exhibited more pronounced seasonal timing shifts
